verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents installing and upgrading gstack: dev-mode symlinks, global vs vendored install detection in /gstack-upgrade, and project-local setup that does not replace a global install. Nothing documents a command to list installed skills or to uninstall them cleanly without leaving orphaned files or injected instructions. The /learn prune feature applies to session learnings, not installed skills, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list what is installed and remove skills cleanly, without orphaned files or lingering instructions
